face.name: 黑骑士
face.text: 可交易 战吼：消灭一个具有嘲讽的敌方随从。
face.flavorText: 巫妖王派他来阻止银色锦标赛的进行。可以说那是个失败。

face.name: The Black Knight
face.flavorText: He was sent by the Lich King to disrupt the Argent Tournament. We can pretty much mark that a failure.

face.name: 纳特·帕格
face.text: 在你的回合开始时，你有50%的几率额外抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 纳特·帕格是艾泽拉斯最棒的钓手！他发明了自动鱼竿3000型，伸缩鱼竿3000型，以及电气自动诱捕器2099型（仍在测试中）。

face.name: Nat Pagle
face.text: At the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to draw an extra card.
face.flavorText: Nat Pagle, Azeroth's premier fisherman! He invented the Auto-Angler 3000, the Extendo-Pole 3000, and the Lure-o-matic 2099 (still in testing).

face.name: 哈里森·琼斯
face.text: 战吼：摧毁对手的武器，并抽数量等同于其耐久度的牌。
face.flavorText: “这东西应该陈列在探险者大厅里！”

face.name: Harrison Jones
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon and draw cards equal to its Durability.
face.flavorText: “That belongs in the Hall of Explorers!”

face.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨
face.text: 战吼： 将一方英雄的剩余生命值变为15。
face.flavorText: 生命的缚誓者阿莱克丝塔萨给所有人带来生命和希望。除了死亡之翼。除了玛里苟斯。除了耐克鲁斯。

face.name: Alexstrasza
face.text: Battlecry: Set a hero's remaining Health to 15.
face.flavorText: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder brings life and hope to everyone. Except Deathwing. And Malygos. And Nekros.

face.name: 比斯巨兽
face.text: 亡语： 为你的对手召唤一个3/3的皮普·急智。
face.flavorText: 他住在黑石山。他吃侏儒。基本上就是这样。

face.name: The Beast
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pip Quickwit for your opponent.
face.flavorText: He lives in Blackrock Mountain. He eats Gnomes. That's pretty much it.

face.name: 米尔豪斯·法力风暴
face.text: 战吼：下个回合敌方法术的法力值消耗为（0）点。
face.flavorText: “我要把你们烤熟了，宝贝儿们！”

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

face.name: 诺兹多姆
face.text: 玩家只有15秒的时间来进行他们的回合。
face.flavorText: 没时间写什么卡牌趣文了。

face.name: Nozdormu
face.text: Players only have 15 seconds to take their turns.
face.flavorText: Time to write some flavor text.

policies.black_knight: Current printed Tradeable hand action and enemy current Taunt predicate; ordinary optional-if-available target, Destroy and Trade.
policies.nat: Own actual turn_started, equal independent Draw-one/empty options; original absent ATK is normalized to zero only against both complete primary faces.
policies.harrison: At each actual Battlecry execution capture the currently equipped enemy weapon and original durability, ordinary Destroy then fixed-count Draw; weapon deathrattle does not reprice draw count.
policies.alexstrasza: Existing SetHeroHealth remaining-life assignment, preserves maximum/armor and emits neither healing nor damage; existing local maximum clamp.
policies.beast: Actual named EX1_finkle summoned for current opposite controller; no same-side death-slot index reused across boards.
policies.millhouse: Source-independent persistent program on opponent; consume exact instance at next actual beneficiary turn_started and install ordinary unlimited SPELL set_to=0 modifier expiring that actual turn. Extra/skipped turns use actual owner start, not global turn+1.

uncertainties: Millhouse activation ordering within turn_started reactions and set-to-zero ordering with other cost modifiers retain existing local semantics pending CN evidence.
Harrison draw after original weapon death/replacement, Alexstrasza reduced maximum and precise reaction ordering retain existing explicit local policies.
Original EX1_560 live battlefield clock provider is still missing; existing CS3_035 original-both-decks opening clock cannot substitute for it.
No formal pool completeness, patch/hotfix alignment or CN boundary calibration claim.
